Dataset: UCI Online Retail II
Domain: E-commerce / Retail
Source: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/502/online+retail+ii
Description: Invoice lines of a UK-based online gift-ware retailer, Dec 2009 - Dec 2011 (sales only; cancellations and returns removed). One record per invoice line.

Columns to validate:
  Quantity (numeric): Units sold on this invoice line
  Price (numeric): Unit price in pounds sterling
  Country (text / categorical): Customer's country
  StockCode (text / categorical): Product code, usually five digits, sometimes followed by a letter
Identifying columns (not validated): Invoice, InvoiceDate

Write the validation rules for the columns above (and for whole records where useful). Return JSON only.
